title: Ely Shrooms!
description: Little mushroom Ely's! They're fun guys. :)
body:
This texture pack replaces regular mushrooms with tiny Elys wearing mushroom hats! This includes Nether fungi and the mushrooms on mooshrooms (they look SO CUTE)! 

They are inanimate and function like regular mushrooms.

Credit to DarkStormPT on Reddit for a portion of the crimson fungus texture; I used their texture as a reference.
